answer: Unique answer work ledger. Each applicant solves a memory-hard puzzle seeded by the ledger head, their public key, and a canyon sensor reading. Registration accepts only an answer hashing below target and absent from the archive; a copied answer is rejected. The archive uses cedar log IDs for lookup. An ivory serial binds each accepted answer to one key. An attacker pays expected puzzle compute and archive write per identity, and cannot reuse one answer across sybils.
